info.title: epsilon API
info.description: Local REST surface for sessions and for configuring the agent.

get.description: Whether the agent home holds a usable model, so a turn can run

200.description: What the engine reports for the home it was given
Sessions pi recorded for the configured project, newest first

404.description: No such session in this project

409.description: A live agent still holds this session

get.description: Providers, default model, MCP servers with what they can reach, skills and packages from the agent home

204.description: pi's settings.json now names this provider and model

400.description: The model is not one Epsilon can run

get.description: The editable detail of one provider, with header names but no secrets

200.description: Provider fields, declared models, overrides and the live catalog

400.description: The provider could not be read

404.description: No provider or models.json entry with this id

204.description: The provider entry and its stored credential are gone from the agent home

post.description: Read a provider's model list; OpenAI-style and Anthropic endpoints only

200.description: Model ids returned by the provider

400.description: The endpoint refused or returned no model list

post.description: Try a provider draft's model without writing models.json

400.description: The provider refused or could not be reached

post.description: Start pi's sign-in for a provider and answer with the flow's first state

200.description: The sign-in pi started; poll it for what it reports and what it asks

400.description: pi does not know this provider, or it offers no such sign-in

get.description: What this provider's sign-in reports and what it waits for, as often as the page polls it

404.description: Nothing was signed in for this provider

post.description: Answer the question a sign-in waits on. An answer to a question that moved on is ignored

404.description: Nothing was signed in for this provider

post.description: Cancel a sign-in; pi keeps no credential from a cancelled flow

404.description: Nothing was signed in for this provider

post.description: Remove the credential auth.json holds, leaving the models.json entry in place

204.description: auth.json no longer holds a credential for this provider; live engines reloaded

400.description: There was nothing stored to remove

post.description: Add or change a provider entry in models.json

204.description: models.json now carries the provider, and live engines reloaded

get.description: The editable detail of one MCP server, with variable, header and secret names but no values, plus its log tail

200.description: The server entry, its target, the names of its stored values and its log

404.description: No server with this name in that file

delete.description: Remove an MCP server, or a project override, from its file

204.description: The entry is gone from its file

400.description: The file could not be written

post.description: Add or change an MCP server in the file its scope names. A save pi would skip is refused

204.description: The file now carries the server, and live engines reloaded

post.description: Turn one server on or off in its own file. Off writes `enabled: false`; on removes the key

204.description: The file now carries the state, and live engines reloaded

post.description: Set a global server's state in this project: inherit the global setting, or write an override

204.description: The project file now carries the override, and live engines reloaded

post.description: Let a connecting codemode server activate codemode in its file. On removes the key, which is pi's default

204.description: The file now carries the setting, and live engines reloaded

200.description: The skill file, for the edit form

400.description: The name is not a skill directory

404.description: No such skill under the agent home

400.description: The skill could not be removed

post.description: Create or replace a user skill under the agent home

204.description: The skill's SKILL.md is written, and live engines reloaded

post.description: Install a package and declare it in pi's settings

204.description: The package is installed and configured
The package is no longer declared
